### Main questions

This document contains all of the data required for analysing the AnswerALS data.


### 1.0 Package requirements

- change to current working directory `/home/koustav/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis/22-scrnaseq-data-analysis` and include required packages 

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

setwd("/home/koustav/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis/")
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(rtracklayer)
library(sctransform)
library(glmGamPoi)

```

### 2.0 Include experiment matrix

- Let's first import the counts.

```{r include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

analysis_path <- "22-scrnaseq-data-analysis"
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "rdata_files")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "plots")
input_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "input_files")
output_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "output_files")

dir.create(save_dir, recursive = T)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = T)
dir.create(input_dir, recursive = T)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = T)

```


### 3.0 Analysis

- Fetch the annotation

```{r}

annotation_gtf <- "/data/shared/public_datasets/Genomes/ENSEMBL_hg38/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.104.chr_patch_hapl_scaff.gtf"
annotation_ranges <- import.gff2(annotation_gtf)
gene_ranges <- annotation_ranges[annotation_ranges$type == "gene"]

```

- Create Seurat object for the reference spinal cord data

```{r}

library(Seurat)
# colnames(reference)[!(colnames(reference) %in% rownames(ref_metadata))]

# identical(
#     colnames(ref_count_matrix),
#     rownames(ref_metadata)
# )

reference <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = ref_count_matrix,
    meta.data = ref_metadata,
    project = "GSE190442")

reference$cell_type <- reference$top_level_annotation
reference$cell_subtype <- reference$subtype_annotation
reference$donor <- reference$sample    

table(reference$cell_type)

```

- Perform scTransform for the reference data

```{r}

library(future)

options(future.globals.maxSize = Inf)

future::plan(
    future::sequential,
    maxSizeOfObjects = Inf
)

reference <- SCTransform(
    reference,
    assay = "RNA",
    conserve.memory = TRUE,
    verbose = T)

reference <- RunPCA(
    reference,
    npcs = 50,
    verbose = FALSE
)

reference <- RunUMAP(
    reference,
    reduction = "pca",
    dims = 1:30,
    return.model = TRUE
)

```
- Load the count data for zelic et al.

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

zelic_seurat_object <- readRDS("/data/shared/public_datasets/scrnaseq-als-spinal-cord-zelic-2025/nfcore/star/mtx_conversions/combined_cellbender_filter_matrix.seurat.rds")
LayerData(zelic_seurat_object, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts") <- LayerData(zelic_seurat_object, assay = "RNA", layer = "count")

```

- Select cells removing for mitochondrial contamination

```{r}

zelic_seurat_qc <- subset(
  zelic_seurat_object,
  subset = nFeature_RNA >= 200 & percent.mt < 5
)

```

- Replace gene names

```{r}

require("Matrix")
gene_names <- gene_ranges$gene_name[match(rownames(zelic_seurat_qc), gene_ranges$gene_id)]
na_filter <- !is.na(gene_names)
zelic_seurat_qc <- zelic_seurat_qc[na_filter,]
gene_names <- gene_ranges$gene_name[match(rownames(zelic_seurat_qc), gene_ranges$gene_id)]
# rownames(query) <- gene_names

# 1. Extract the count matrix from the existing assay (e.g., RNA)
count_data <- LayerData(zelic_seurat_qc, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

unique_gene_name <- unique(gene_names)

collapse_matrix <- sparseMatrix(
    i = match(gene_names, unique_gene_name),
    j = seq_along(gene_names),
    x = 1,
    dims = c(
        length(unique_gene_name),
        length(gene_names)
    ),
    dimnames = list(
        unique_gene_name,
        rownames(zelic_seurat_qc)
    )
)

gene_name_counts <- collapse_matrix %*% count_data
# sum(count_data) == sum(gene_name_counts)
# 3. Create a new assay object with the renamed matrix
new_assay <- CreateAssayObject(counts = gene_name_counts)

# 4. Replace the old assay in your Seurat object
zelic_seurat_qc[["RNA"]] <- new_assay

```


- Run scTransform on the zelic dataset

```{r}

options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)  # 8 GiB
future::plan(future::sequential)

query <- zelic_seurat_qc
DefaultAssay(query) <- "RNA"

query <- SCTransform(
    query,
    assay = "RNA",
    conserve.memory = TRUE,
    verbose = FALSE
)

DefaultAssay(query) <- "SCT"

query <- RunPCA(
    query,
    npcs = 50,
    verbose = FALSE
)

query <- RunUMAP(
    query,
    reduction = "pca",
    dims = 1:30,
    return.model = TRUE
)

```

- Find anchors to project the query from reference

```{r}

anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
    reference = reference,
    query = query,
    normalization.method = "SCT",
    reference.assay = "SCT",
    query.assay = "SCT",
    reference.reduction = "pca",
    reduction = "pcaproject",
    dims = 1:30
)

class(anchors@anchors)

```

- Make a projection on the query

```{r}

query <- MapQuery(
    anchorset = anchors,
    query = query,
    reference = reference,
    refdata = list(
        cell_type = "cell_type",
        cell_subtype = "cell_subtype"
    ),
    reference.reduction = "pca",
    reduction.model = "umap"
)

```

- Fetch the seurat_clusters

```{r}

query <- FindNeighbors(
    query,
    reduction = "pca",
    dims = 1:30
)

query <- FindClusters(
    query,
    resolution = 0.5
)

table(query$seurat_clusters)

```

- Make a list of candidate cells

```{r}


astro <- subset(
    query,
    subset = predicted.cell_type == "Astrcytes"
)

astro_core <- subset(
    query,
    subset =
        predicted.cell_type == "Astrcytes" &
        seurat_clusters %in% c(2, 9)
)

list_of_cell_programs <- list(
    reference_annotated_astrocytes = astro, 
    reference_annotated_and_clustered_astrocytes = astro_core) 

saveRDS(
     Idents(query),
    file = file.path(save_dir, "01-reference-annotation-idents.rds")
)

saveRDS(
    query[[]],
    file = file.path(
        save_dir,
        "01-reference-annotation-metadata.rds"
    )
)

rna_counts <- LayerData(
    query,
    assay = "RNA",
    layer = "counts"
)
query_save <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = rna_counts,
    meta.data = query[[]],
    project = Project(query)
)
Idents(query_save) <- Idents(query)

if ("data" %in% Layers(query[["RNA"]])) {

    LayerData(
        query_save,
        assay = "RNA",
        layer = "data"
    ) <- LayerData(
        query,
        assay = "RNA",
        layer = "data"
    )
}

reductions_to_keep <- intersect(
    c("pca", "umap", "ref.pca", "ref.umap"),
    Reductions(query)
)

for (red in reductions_to_keep) {
    query_save[[red]] <- query[[red]]
}

saveRDS(
    query_save,
    file = file.path(
        save_dir,
        "01-saved-list-of-reference-annotated-cells.rds"
    ),
    compress = FALSE
)

saveRDS(file = file.path(save_dir, "01-saved-list-of-reference-informed-astrocyte-classified-cells.rds"), 
        object = list_of_cell_programs)

```

- Load the gene list from WGCNA

```{r}

genic_count_list <- readRDS(file.path("11-postmortem-data-analysis/rdata_files/", "01-gene-level-counts-of-postmortem-samples.rds"))
wgcna_modules_df <- readRDS(file.path("11-postmortem-data-analysis/rdata_files/", "04-postmortem-WGCNA-gene-modules.rds"))

erap2_module_df <- wgcna_modules_df[wgcna_modules_df$modules == "M3",]
module_df_no_erap2 <- erap2_module_df[erap2_module_df$gene_name != "ERAP2" & !is.na(erap2_module_df$gene_name),]
gene_list_no_erap2 <- erap2_module_df$gene_name[erap2_module_df$gene_name != "ERAP2"]

gene_count_matrix <- genic_count_list$counts
cpm_matrix <- t(t(gene_count_matrix) / (colSums(gene_count_matrix)/1e6))

```

- Get the patient metadata

```{r}

coldata_df <- genic_count_list$coldata
coldata_df$expr <- cpm_matrix[gene_ranges$gene_id[gene_ranges$gene_name == "ERAP2" & !is.na(gene_ranges$gene_name)],
    coldata_df$column_id]
coldata_df$tissue_group <- "spinal_cord"
coldata_df$tissue_group[coldata_df$tissue %in% c("Cortex_Motor", "Cortex", "Cerebellum")] <- "brain"

subset_matrix <- as.data.frame(cpm_matrix[rownames(cpm_matrix) %in% 
    gene_ranges$gene_id[gene_ranges$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"],])
keep_matrix <- subset_matrix[(rowSums(subset_matrix == 0) / ncol(subset_matrix)) < 0.10,]


coldata_df$matrix_row <- match(coldata_df$column_id, colnames(keep_matrix))

cols_split_by_patient <- split(coldata_df, paste(coldata_df$subject_id, coldata_df$tissue))

patient_matrix <- do.call(cbind, lapply(cols_split_by_patient, function(x){
    if(nrow(x) == 1){
        return(keep_matrix[,x$matrix_row])
    }
    return(rowMeans(keep_matrix[,x$matrix_row]))
}))
selected_patient_matrix <- patient_matrix[module_df_no_erap2$genes,]


patient_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cols_split_by_patient, function(temp_df){
    return_df <- unique(temp_df[,!(colnames(temp_df) %in% 
        c("X", "sample_name", "alignment_file", "alignment_file_dir",
          "isPairedEnd", "strand_specificity", "samplesheet_path", 
          "column_id", "sample_id", "mutation", "site_of_motor_onset",
          "instrument", "rin", "expr", "tissue_group", "matrix_row"))])
    if(nrow(return_df) > 1){
        # message(paste(unique(return_df$subject_id), unique(return_df$tissue)))
        if("N/A" %in% return_df$mnd_with_ftd & "Yes" %in% return_df$mnd_with_ftd){
            return_df <- return_df[return_df$mnd_with_ftd == "Yes",]
        }else if("N/A" %in% return_df$mnd_with_ftd & "No" %in% return_df$mnd_with_ftd){
            return_df <- return_df[return_df$mnd_with_ftd == "No",]
        }else{
            stop(paste(return_df$subject_id, return_df$tissue))
        }
        # message(nrow(return_df))
    }
    # return_df$expr <- mean(temp_df$expr)
    return_df$column_id <- paste(return_df$subject_id, return_df$tissue)
    return(return_df)
}))
patient_df$age_at_death[patient_df$age_at_death == "90 or Older"] <- "90"
patient_df$age_at_death <- as.numeric(patient_df$age_at_death)
patient_df$age_at_onset <- as.numeric(patient_df$age_at_symptom_onset)
patient_df$disease_duration <- as.numeric(patient_df$disease_duration_in_months)
patient_df$disease_duration_in_months <- as.numeric(patient_df$disease_duration_in_months)

# Select cervical patient data

cervical_patient_df <- patient_df[patient_df$tissue == "Spinal_Cord_Cervical",]
cervical_selected_matrix <- selected_patient_matrix[,cervical_patient_df$column_id]
rownames(cervical_selected_matrix) <- module_df_no_erap2$gene_name
cervical_erap2_matrix <- patient_matrix[erap2_module_df[erap2_module_df$gene_name == "ERAP2" & !is.na(erap2_module_df$gene_name),1],cervical_patient_df$column_id]

```

- Assign predictor matrix and erap2 response data

```{r}

X <- cervical_selected_matrix
y <- cervical_erap2_matrix

# Remove genes with no variance

keep <- apply(
    X,
    2,
    sd,
    na.rm = TRUE
) > 0

X <- X[, keep, drop = FALSE]
dim(X)

```

- scale values

```{r}

X_z <- scale(X)
y_z <- as.numeric(scale(y))

```

- Fit an elastic net regression model

```{r}

library(glmnet)

if (!file.exists(file.path(save_dir, "02-seed-file-for-glmnet-regression-models.rds"))) {
    seed_list <- sample.int(.Machine$integer.max, 100)
    saveRDS(object = seed_list, file = file.path(save_dir, "02-seed-file-for-glmnet-regression-models.rds"))
} else {
    seed_list <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "02-seed-file-for-glmnet-regression-models.rds"))
}

model_list <- lapply(seed_list, function(x){
    set.seed(x)
    cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
        x = t(X_z),
        y = y_z,
        family = "gaussian",
        alpha = 0.5,
        standardize = FALSE,
        nfolds = 10,
        keep = TRUE
    )
    return(cv_fit)
})

```

- Identify lambda min

```{r}

require(matrixStats)
# Fetch goi_pred_oof
goi_pred_oof_list <- do.call(cbind, lapply(model_list, function(x){
    lambda_index <- which.min(
        abs(x$lambda - x$lambda.min)
    )
    goi_pred_oof <- x$fit.preval[, lambda_index]
    goi_pred_oof
}))

goi_pred_oof <- rowMedians(goi_pred_oof_list)

cor.test(
    goi_pred_oof,
    y_z,
    method = "spearman"
)
#         Spearman's rank correlation rho

# data:  goi_pred_oof and y_z
# S = 764598, p-value = 1.178e-09
# alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
# sample estimates:
#       rho 
# 0.4178483 

cor_values <- vapply(model_list, function(x){
    lambda_index <- which.min(
        abs(x$lambda - x$lambda.min)
    )
    goi_pred_oof <- x$fit.preval[, lambda_index]
    cor_results <- cor.test(
        goi_pred_oof,
        y_z,
        method = "spearman"
    )
    cor_results$estimate
},1)

median(cor_values)
# [1] 0.4022324

```

- Plot the correlation

```{r}

pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "11-plot-correlation-between-erap2-expression-and-predicted-expression.pdf"))
plot(
    y_z,
    goi_pred_oof,
    xlab = "Observed ERAP2 expression",
    ylab = "Out-of-fold predicted GOI expression"
)

abline(lm(goi_pred_oof ~ y_z))
dev.off()

```

- Create the final models

```{r}

signature_weight_list <- lapply(seq_along(seed_list), function(x){
    set.seed(seed_list[x])

    final_fit <- glmnet(
    x = t(X_z),
    y = y_z,
    family = "gaussian",
    alpha = 0.5,
    standardize = FALSE)

    coef_mat <- as.matrix(
        coef(
            final_fit,
            s = cv_fit$lambda.min
        )
    )

    signature <- data.frame(
        gene = rownames(coef_mat),
        beta = coef_mat[, 1]
    )

    signature <- subset(
        signature,
        gene != "(Intercept)" &
        beta != 0
    )

    signature$weight <- signature$beta / sum(abs(signature$beta))
    signature$iter <- x
    return(signature)
})
signature_df <- do.call(rbind, signature_weight_list)
signature_matrix <- reshape2::acast(data = signature_df, formula = gene ~ iter, value.var = "weight")
signature_weights <- rowMeans(signature_matrix)

```

```{r}

expr_z <- t(

        names(signature_weights)

]
weights <- weights /
```


- Aggregate astrocyte counts by patients

```{r}

pb <- AggregateExpression(
    astro_core,
    assays = "RNA",
    group.by = "patient_id",
    return.seurat = FALSE
)$RNA

library(edgeR)

dge <- DGEList(counts = pb)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

logCPM <- cpm(
    dge,
    log = TRUE,
    prior.count = 1
)

sig_genes <- intersect(
    names(signature_weights),
    rownames(logCPM)
)

pb_sig <- logCPM[
    sig_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
]


```

- Fetch relative module score

```{r}

pb_sig_z <- t(
    scale(
        t(pb_sig)
    )
)

weights <- signature_weights[
    match(
        rownames(pb_sig_z),
        names(signature_weights)
    )
]

stopifnot(!anyNA(weights))

weights <- weights / sum(abs(weights))

```

- Get score per patient

```{r}

pb_GOI_score <- as.numeric(
    crossprod(

        pb_sig_z

)

names(pb_GOI_score) <- colnames(pb_sig_z)
```
